description.en: Rewinds a conversation to an earlier user message in place: the target message and everything after it are masked from both the model context and the rendered thread, and the target text is refilled into the composer, without starting a new branch. Optionally restores workspace files from lightweight pre-write backups, and keeps a per-workspace rewind history that can undo the latest file restore.
description.zh: 就地回退对话到任意更早的用户消息：目标消息及其之后的内容同时从模型上下文与渲染对话中撤回，目标文本回填输入框，不新建会话分支。可选一并还原工作区文件（写前轻量备份），并保留按工作区记录的回退历史，可对最近一次回退做文件撤销。
